'''Hayle''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[New Republic officer]] within the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]]. Holding the [[military rank]] of [[captain]],<ref name="Part One: Master and Apprentice /> Hayle previously served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="Databank" /> before joining its successor government where he later became the [[commanding officer]] of the [[Defender-class cruiser|''Defender''-class cruiser]] ''[[Vesper]]''<ref name="Part One Highlights">{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-part-1-master-and-apprentice-highlights|text=''Ahsoka'' Analyzed: 5 Highlights from "Part One: Master and Apprentice"}}</ref> [[transport]]ing the captive [[Morgan Elsbeth]]. Hayle was [[Death|killed]] by the former [[Jedi]] [[Baylan Skoll]] in his [[Attack on the Vesper|rescue]] of Elsbeth.<ref name="Part One: Master and Apprentice />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hayle first appeared in the first episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'' which was released on [[August 22]], [[2023]]. He was portrayed by [[Mark Rolston]].<ref name="Part One: Master and Apprentice />
